catalogs.title: TR-6 tomato sRGB
catalogs.note: Collected metadata catalog; specimen identity and filename-derived capture times are unverified. Not the 18-frame demo sequence.

catalogs.title: Manalagi apple disease dataset
catalogs.note: Nimble provenance retained per source file. Includes raw and processed subsets; source files are not independent apples. Duplicate database rows are counted separately.

queries.name: tomato_lha_tr6_frames_counts
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS physical_rows, uniqExact(toString(frame_id)) AS unique_frame_ids, uniqExact(toString(sha256)) AS unique_image_hashes FROM tomato_lha_tr6_frames WHERE toString(dataset_id) = 'tr6_tomato_srgb'

queries.name: tomato_lha_tr6_frames_samples
queries.sql: SELECT frame_id, dataset_id, frame_uri, source_url, sha256, collection_status, timestamp_verified, entity_identity_verified FROM tomato_lha_tr6_frames WHERE toString(dataset_id) = 'tr6_tomato_srgb' ORDER BY toString(frame_id) LIMIT 2

queries.name: apple_lha_nimble_frames_counts
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS physical_rows, uniqExact(toString(frame_id)) AS unique_frame_ids, uniqExact(toString(source_sha1)) AS unique_image_hashes FROM apple_lha_nimble_frames WHERE toString(dataset_id) = 'nimble_apple_mendeley_9zgkwwv9j8'

queries.name: apple_lha_nimble_frames_samples
queries.sql: SELECT frame_id, dataset_id, frame_uri, source_url, source_sha1, subset, label, file_present, nimble_task_id FROM apple_lha_nimble_frames WHERE toString(dataset_id) = 'nimble_apple_mendeley_9zgkwwv9j8' ORDER BY toString(frame_id) LIMIT 2
